verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Sketch's free access is limited to inviting developers/stakeholders to inspect, view, and comment via the web app (sketch-docs-2, sketch-docs-29, sketch-docs-62), while actual design/editing happens in the paid Mac app (sketch-docs-52). The only 'free' offer for editing is a 30-day trial, not a persistent free tier (sketch-docs-61), and no evidence describes a genuinely usable free editor or free collaborative editing seat.
